sloka: चतुर् दश सहस्राणि रक्ष्साम् काम रूपिणाम् ।खर दूषण मुख्यानाम् निहतानि महामृधे ॥३-३०-३१॥
transliteration: catur daśa sahasrāṇi rakṣsām kāma rūpiṇām ।khara dūṣaṇa mukhyānām nihatāni mahāmṛdhe ॥3-30-31॥

translations.english: You are brought to this place by the great sages who had cleverly devised a plan to kill the cruel sinners, these demons৷৷
